value.summary: Bumped the shared API version: packages/shared/meta.mjs now exports API = "v2". Rewrote apiName() in packages/a and packages/b to derive from the shared constant (`api-${API}` from ../shared/meta.mjs) instead of their hardcoded "api-v1" strings, so apiName() returns "api-v2" in both packages and future bumps propagate from one place. Updated tests/api.test.mjs to expect "api-v2" for both. Ran the suite with node --test; all tests pass. Satisfied: shared constant bumped, both consumers updated and now single-sourced, tests updated and green.
